definitions.explanation: A flaw or shortcoming in something or someone.

examples.japanese: {欠点|けってん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{直|なお}す→直す：00869_naosu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{欠点|けってん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The drawback of this product is its high price.

notes:
{欠点|けってん} means a fault, defect, or weakness in something or someone.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {欠点|けってん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have faults
- {欠点|けってん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{直|なお}す→直す：00869_naosu⟧: to fix one's faults
- {欠点|けってん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{補|おぎな}う→補う：00329_oginau⟧: to compensate for weaknesses
- {欠点|けってん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指摘|してき}する→指摘する：27890_shitekisuru⟧: to point out faults

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{短所|たんしょ}→短所：04506_tansho⟧: weakness, shortcoming (often for personality traits)
- ⟦{弱点|じゃくてん}→弱点：12497_jakuten⟧: weak point (strategic or competitive)
- ⟦{欠陥|けっかん}→欠陥：02793_kekkan⟧: defect (more serious, used for products/systems)
- ⟦{長所|ちょうしょ}→長所：03121_chousho⟧: strong point, merit
- ⟦{利点|りてん}→利点：11787_riten⟧: advantage
